title: Cosmic Origins of Gold
hook: Every gold atom in your ring was born in a cosmic explosion.
script: Every atom of gold in your jewelry was born from a cosmic collision! Ever wondered if you could trace its roots to the stars? Neutron star collisions unleash energy equal to 1,000 supernovae, forming gold instantly! Picture squeezing all humanity into a sugar cube; that's a neutron star's density! GW170817, the first collision witnessed, confirmed these events forge elements heavier than iron! This gold predates the Sun, born when the fabric of space-time rippled!
